task: Display the figure comparing unemployment trends among women in Illinois and Michigan.
agent_final_answer:
The figure comparing unemployment trends among women in Illinois and Michigan is now displayed on America's Health Rankings at:
https://www.americashealthrankings.org/explore/measures/unemployment_women/IL/compare/MI

The chart displays the annual percentage of the female civilian workforce that is unemployed across data years 2017 through 2023 for both Illinois (represented by circular markers) and Michigan (represented by square markers).
